title: Before the Ticket: Grounding HPC User Support in Documentation and Resolved Tickets with an Agentic LLM Assistant
title_zh: 在工单之前：基于文档与已解决工单的HPC用户支持智能体式LLM助手

paragraphs.en: Most questions that reach an HPC help desk have already been answered, in the center’s user guides or in a ticket someone else filed last semester; users still file new tickets because the guides are hard to navigate and the ticket history is not theirs to search. We present an assistant that answers from both sources: an orchestrator calls two tools over the Model Context Protocol, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the live documentation and a Llama-3-8B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on 11,244 query–resolution pairs mined from historical tickets, and merges their answers. Every model runs on-premises or on the university’s hosted LLM service, because ticket data may not leave the institution. On 400 held-out tickets from Purdue’s Rosen Center for Advanced Computing, ticket-disjoint and free of near-duplicates from training, and with two judges from model families that generated none of the answers, fine-tuning on resolutions rewritten into self-service guidance is the clear winner on agreement with RCAC’s resolutions (BERTScore F1 0.06 → \rightarrow 0.27 over the base model) and is judged most correct on average. The end-to-end system does not improve on its tools, although they are complementary: choosing the better answer per question would exceed either (judged correctness 3.41 vs. 3.20, an oracle bound), while the merge follows the documentation tool in 78% of answers. Returning one tool’s answer instead recovers the fine-tuned tool’s quality (3.19 vs. 2.66), but neither a learned selector nor an LLM verifier beats that tool alone.
paragraphs.zh: 到达 HPC 服务台的大多数问题其实早已得到解答——要么在计算中心的用户指南中，要么在上学期其他人提交的工单里；用户之所以仍然提交新工单，是因为指南难以导航，而工单历史也并非供他们检索的资源。 我们提出一个能够同时从这两类来源作答的助手：一个编排器通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）调用两个工具——对实时文档进行检索增强生成（RAG），以及在从历史工单中挖掘出的 11,244 组查询–解决方案对上用 QLoRA 微调的 Llama-3-8B 模型——并合并两者的答案。 所有模型均在本地或大学托管的 LLM 服务上运行，因为工单数据不得离开本机构。 在来自普渡大学 Rosen 高级计算中心的 400 个保留工单上——这些工单与训练数据不含相同工单、剔除了近重复样本，且由两个来自未生成任何答案的模型家族的评审员评分——在解决方案被改写为自助式指南的语料上微调，是与 RCAC 解决方案一致性上的明显胜者（相对基础模型 BERTScore F1 从 0.06 \rightarrow 0.27），且平均被判为最正确。 端到端系统并未超越其组成工具，尽管二者是互补的：若每个问题都择优选取答案，将超过任一单独工具（判定正确性 3.41 对 3.20，这是一个上界/oracle 界限），而合并结果在 78% 的答案中跟随了文档工具。 改为直接返回单一工具的答案则可恢复微调工具的质量（3.19 对 2.66），但无论是学习型选择器还是 LLM 验证器，都无法胜过单独使用该工具。

paragraphs.en: A research computing center is a strange kind of product: thousands of nodes, dozens of file systems and schedulers, hundreds of software modules, and a user base of physicists, biologists, and economists who would rather not learn any of it. Most of them never took a course on it; HPC has only recently entered undergraduate curricula [ 17 ] . When a job fails or a module will not load, they file a ticket. One large public-university center logged more than 20,000 tickets and nearly 95,000 messages between 2017 and 2023, with an average resolution time of 11.8 business days [ 20 ] ; help-desk staff across industries report spending 60–70% of their time on problems they have solved before [ 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 研究计算中心是一种奇怪的产品：数千个节点、数十个文件系统和调度器、数百个软件模块，以及一群宁愿什么都不想学的用户——物理学家、生物学家和经济学家。 他们大多数人从未上过相关课程；高性能计算（HPC）只是最近才进入本科课程体系 [ 17 ] 。 当作业失败或模块无法加载时，他们就提交工单。 某大型公立大学计算中心在2017年至2023年间记录了超过20,000个工单和近95,000条消息，平均解决时间为11.8个工作日 [ 20 ] ；各行业的帮助台工作人员报告称，他们60%到70%的时间花在以前已经解决过的问题上 [ 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The frustrating part is that the answers usually exist. Every center maintains user guides. Every ticketing system is, in effect, a growing FAQ written by the support team one reply at a time. But the two live in different places and hold different kinds of knowledge. Documentation is authoritative and kept current, but it describes the system as designed; it is silent on the specific error a user is staring at and on the shortcuts staff reach for in practice. Ticket history captures exactly that tacit, experiential knowledge, but it is not accessible to users (tickets contain other people’s data), it ages as the system changes, and nobody has time to curate it. A good support answer often needs both: what the manual says and what actually fixed it last time.
paragraphs.zh: 令人沮丧的地方在于，答案通常是存在的。 每个中心都维护着用户指南。 事实上，每个工单系统都是一份不断增长的 FAQ，由支持团队一次一个回复地写就。 但这两者存在于不同的地方，承载着不同类型的知识。 文档具有权威性且保持更新，但它描述的是设计中的系统；对于用户正面对的具体错误，以及工作人员在实践中使用的捷径，它只字未提。 工单历史恰恰记录了那种隐性的、来自经验的知识，但用户无法访问它（工单包含其他人的数据），它也会随着系统变化而过时，而且没人有时间去整理它。 一个好的支持答案往往两者都需要：手册上说的，以及上次实际解决问题的办法。

paragraphs.en: Large language models make it possible to put both sources behind one conversation. The question we address is how to combine them so that answers stay grounded, under the practical constraint that ticket data cannot leave the institution and so the models must be small enough to run on local or institutionally hosted hardware. Prior LLM work on IT support has mostly automated the pipeline after a ticket is filed, classification, routing, escalation, FAQ generation [ 29 , 15 , 12 , 9 ] . We instead intervene before the ticket.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型使得可以将这两个信息源置于同一场对话之后。 我们要解决的是如何将二者结合起来，使答案保持有据可依，同时还要满足实际约束：工单数据不能离开机构，因此模型必须足够小，以便在本地或机构托管硬件上运行。 此前关于IT支持的大语言模型研究主要自动化了工单提交之后的流程：分类、路由、升级、FAQ生成 [ 29 , 15 , 12 , 9 ] 。 我们则是在工单提交之前进行干预。

paragraphs.en: An agentic architecture in which an orchestrator routes queries to two MCP-exposed tools, RAG over official documentation and a fine-tuned model over resolved tickets, and synthesizes their outputs with an explicit precedence rule and source attribution (Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种智能体架构，其中编排器（orchestrator）将查询路由到两个通过 MCP 暴露的工具——基于官方文档的 RAG 和基于已解决工单的微调模型——并按照明确的优先级规则和来源标注（source attribution）综合二者的输出（Section 3）。

paragraphs.en: A pipeline that turns raw ticket threads into assistant-safe training data : LLM extraction of query–resolution pairs, rewriting of staff-performed resolutions into self-service guidance, filtering of answers that claim actions, residual PII masking, and a ticket-level, near-duplicate-free split (Section 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一条将原始工单对话线程转化为对助手安全的训练数据的流水线：利用大语言模型抽取「查询–解决」配对，将员工执行的解决方案改写为自助式指南，过滤声称执行了操作的回答，进行残余 PII 脱敏，并在工单层面进行近乎无重复的数据切分（第 2 节）。

paragraphs.en: A controlled evaluation of five systems on the same 400 held-out tickets (base model, fine-tuned model, RAG over documentation, RAG over tickets, end-to-end system) with reference metrics, two independent LLM judges, and paired bootstrap intervals (Section 4 ). Fine-tuning wins on agreement with staff resolutions; the two tools are complementary, but the synthesis does not improve on them, and selectors developed on validation data recover the fine-tuned tool’s quality without exceeding it; judge choice and answer length change the picture enough that neither can be left out of a report.
paragraphs.zh: 对五个系统在同一批 400 张留存工单上进行对照评估（基础模型、微调模型、基于文档的 RAG、基于工单的 RAG、端到端系统），采用参考指标、两个独立的 LLM 评委以及配对自助法置信区间（第 4 节）。 微调在与员工处理结果的一致性上胜出；两种工具互为补充，但其综合并未带来改进，而在验证数据上开发的 selector 能够恢复微调工具的质量但未能超越它；评委的选择和答案长度足以改变结论，以至于二者都不能在报告中省略。

paragraphs.en: A ticket’s customernote field is the whole conversation, problem statement, clarifying questions, staff replies, signatures, quoted e-mail, Jira markup. Five steps turn it into something a model can learn from and be tested on.
paragraphs.zh: 工单的 customernote 字段是整段对话内容：问题描述、澄清性提问、工作人员回复、签名、引用的电子邮件、Jira 标记。 只需五个步骤，就能把它变成可供模型学习并进行测试的内容。

paragraphs.en: Clean and pseudonymise. Records with no note were dropped. Submitter and assignee fields were mapped to stable pseudonyms so repeat-user and workload analyses remain possible without identities. A fixed pipeline then stripped hyphen runs, HTML, issue-tracker markup, and non-ASCII residue; normalized Unicode and whitespace; and replaced e-mail addresses, and names matching the submitter and assignee lists, with [EMAIL] and [NAME] placeholders, which keep sentences grammatical.

paragraphs.en: Extract query–resolution pairs with an LLM. [9] fine-tuned for this exact task, using three independent LLM judges (ChatGPT (GPT-4o mini), Gemini (3.5 Flash) and Claude Opus 4.8, through their chat interfaces). Prompted Gemma 3 matched the purpose-built Mistral model (issue extraction 9.0 vs. 8.0; equal hallucination-risk and RAG-suitability scores) and clearly beat Llama-4, so we used it without any fine-tuning. Extraction ran on Purdue’s on-premises GenAI Studio so proprietary data stayed inside university infrastructure; it was parallelised with retries and checkpoints, and tickets that came back empty were retried up to twice more. paragraphs.en: Rewrite staff actions; remove non-answers. This step turned out to matter. Many resolutions say what the engineer did: “I’ve added you to the standby queue and bumped your scratch quota to 200 GB.” Others record a passing state: “Geddes is under maintenance; we’ll update you.” An assistant trained on these will claim to have granted access it cannot grant and assert outages it cannot see. Every resolution was passed through a rewriting prompt for Gemma 3, which left self-service answers essentially unchanged and turned staff actions into user-facing guidance that keeps the technical content and explains how to request the privileged change (8 rewrites failed, leaving 13,324 pairs). Rewriting does not catch everything, so answers that still claim an action or report a transient state were removed with regular-expression rules. A first set of rules (“has been added”, “you should now be able to”, “are investigating”) missed about 3% of such answers, for example “The data depot should now be accessible” and “Your purchased 2TB quota has been applied”; the extended rules removed 632 pairs in total (4.7%), leaving 12,692. The rules are deliberately strict and also catch some useful answers.
paragraphs.zh: 重写员工操作；移除非答案。 这一步结果证明很重要。 许多解决方案记录的是工程师做了什么：「我已将你加入备用队列，并将你的临时配额提升到 200 GB。」另一些记录的是一种临时状态：「Geddes 正在维护中，我们会随时通知你。」在这些数据上训练出的智能体会声称自己授予了它无法授予的权限，并断言它无法看到的故障。 每条解决方案都通过一个面向 Gemma 3 的重写提示词处理，该提示词基本保持自助服务答案不变，并将员工操作转化为面向用户的指引，既保留技术内容，又说明如何请求该特权变更（8 次重写失败，留下 13,324 对数据）。 重写并不能捕获所有问题，因此仍声称执行了操作或报告了临时状态的答案通过正则表达式规则被移除。 第一组规则（「has been added」「you should now be able to」「are investigating」）漏掉了大约 3% 的此类答案，例如「The data depot should now be accessible」和「Your purchased 2TB quota has been applied」；扩展后的规则共移除了 632 对数据（4.7%），留下 12,692 对。 这些规则刻意设置得较为严格，因此也会误捕一些有用的答案。

paragraphs.en: Mask residual PII. The upstream pseudonymisation missed identifiers that a fine-tuned model can learn and repeat. A second pass, with the same placeholders, masked personal e-mail addresses (published support addresses such as rcac-help@purdue.edu are kept), phone numbers, people’s names (from the submitter and assignee lists of the raw exports, names after a title such as “Prof.”, and the name preceding a masked address), and usernames (submitter identifiers and the account list, plus the identifier after “account”, “username” or “login”, keeping English words, documentation terms, and project allocation identifiers). It masked 4,557 values, 3,773 of them usernames; afterwards no personal e-mail address or phone number remains in any split. Names absent from the exports and not marked by a title or an address can still slip through, which is one reason the data and the fine-tuned model are not released.

paragraphs.en: Split without leakage. Exact-duplicate questions were dropped (48), leaving 12,644 pairs. Pairs were then assigned to splits by ticket , with a fixed seed, so that the several pairs extracted from one ticket never straddle splits, and test and validation questions whose embedding ( all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ) has cosine similarity ≥ \geq 0.92 with any training question, or with another kept question of the same split, were removed, so that a user re-filing the same issue cannot place the test answer in the training data. The result is 11,244 training pairs, 600 validation pairs used only for validation loss and early stopping, and 400 test pairs used only for the evaluation in Section 4 . Rebuilding the split reproduces the files byte for byte; their hashes are checked before training.
paragraphs.zh: 划分时避免信息泄漏。 完全重复的问题被剔除（48 条），剩下 12,644 个问答对。 然后按工单将问答对分配到各数据划分中，使用固定随机种子，使从同一工单提取的多个问答对绝不跨划分；此外，测试集和验证集中与任一训练问题、或与同划分中另一保留问题的嵌入（all-MiniLM-L6-v2）余弦相似度 ≥ \geq 0.92 的问题也被移除，从而确保用户再次提交同一问题时，不会把测试答案放入训练数据中。 最终得到 11,244 个训练问答对、600 个仅用于验证损失和早停的验证问答对，以及 400 个仅用于第 4 节评估的测试问答对。 重新执行划分过程可逐字节复现这些文件；训练前会校验其哈希值。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the design. We call it agentic in the sense of Sapkota et al. [22] : an LLM operates through an orchestration layer that decides how to handle each query and calls external tools rather than answering from parametric memory. The choice follows directly from the two-sources argument in the introduction. Keeping documentation and tickets in separate tools means each answer component stays grounded in its own material, and the orchestrator, not the training data, decides how to reconcile them.
paragraphs.zh: 图1展示了该设计。 我们按照 Sapkota 等人的定义称其为「智能体的」。 [22]：大语言模型通过一个编排层运作，该层决定如何处理每个查询并调用外部工具，而不是依靠参数记忆作答。 这一选择直接源于引言中的「双来源」论证。 将文档和工单保存在不同的工具中，意味着每个答案的组成部分始终锚定于其自身的材料，而由编排器而非训练数据决定如何协调二者。

paragraphs.en: A second constraint shaped every model choice. Support tickets contain names, paths, project identifiers, and occasionally credentials or grant details; even after de-identification, RCAC’s data governance required that ticket text never be sent to an external API. Fine-tuning therefore had to fit on a single GPU of the center’s own clusters, generation had to run on Purdue’s institutionally hosted GenAI Studio (Llama 3.1), and embeddings had to be computed locally. Section 5 notes where this limits comparison with frontier hosted models.

paragraphs.en: A breadth-first crawler, seeded from the documentation home page and an explicit list of legacy pages on a second domain, collects content pages and discards images, assets, search and tag indices, and admin routes. 849 pages are fetched,and the main content is extracted as structured text: headings are kept, code blocks are fenced and never split, inline code stays inline, and line-number gutters and copy buttons are dropped. Each page is cut into chunks of whole paragraphs and code blocks from a single section, up to 900 characters, each prefixed with its section heading, giving 5,388 chunks. Chunks are embedded, with their page title, by a local Sentence-BERT model ( all-MiniLM-L6-v2 , 384-d) [ 18 ] into a FAISS flat index [ 8 ] , and also indexed with BM25.

paragraphs.en: For each question, candidates come from both the embedding search (top 40) and BM25 (top 40), so that an exact term such as myquota is found even when the embedding is dominated by a cluster name. A cross-encoder ( ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 ) rescores every candidate. Pages documenting a cluster the question did not name are moved below all others, rather than boosting the named cluster, which had pushed relevant general pages out of the results; near-identical copies of one page across cluster guides are collapsed to one; and chunks below a relevance threshold are dropped. The threshold was set so that none of a sample of validation tickets lost all its chunks; when nothing remains the tool answers that the documentation does not cover the question, without calling the model (19 of the 400 test questions). The best six chunks go to Llama 3.1 on GenAI Studio, each labelled with its cluster and its relevance, with instructions to answer only from them, not to build an answer from low-relevance excerpts, to say so when they are not enough and point the user to human support, to ask a clarifying question when the request is ambiguous, and to cite the pages it used. A refresh endpoint re-crawls the documentation and swaps in a new index.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个问题，候选内容同时来自嵌入检索（前 40）和 BM25（前 40），这样即使嵌入结果被某个集群名称主导，也能找到诸如 myquota 这样的精确术语。 一个交叉编码器（ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2）会对每个候选进行重新打分。 记录了问题中未提及的集群的页面会被移到所有其他页面之下，而不是提升被提及集群的排名——后者曾把相关的通用页面挤出结果；同一页面在各个集群指南中几乎相同的副本会被合并为一个；低于相关性阈值的文本块会被丢弃。 阈值的设定保证了验证工单样本中的每一条都至少保留一个文本块；当没有任何内容保留时，工具会回答文档未覆盖该问题，而不再调用模型（400 个测试问题中有 19 个属于这种情况）。 最优的六个文本块被送入 GenAI Studio 上的 Llama 3.1，每个文本块都标注其所属集群和相关性，并附有指令：只依据这些内容回答，不要用低相关性的摘录拼凑答案；当这些内容不够时要说出来，并引导用户寻求人工支持；当请求含糊不清时要提出澄清问题；并引用其所使用的页面。 一个刷新端点会重新爬取文档并换入新的索引。

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuned model. Llama-3-8B-Instruct [ 13 ] was adapted with QLoRA [ 4 , 7 ] through Unsloth on a single NVIDIA A10 GPU of RCAC’s Gilbreth cluster (Table 2 ). Each example is a system/user/assistant exchange; the system message defines an RCAC support agent that gives user-facing guidance, never fabricates technical details, never claims to have performed back-end actions, asks for clarification when needed, and never asks for credentials. The serving configuration sends exactly the same system message. Loss is computed on assistant tokens only. A pilot sweep over { 1 , 2 , 3 } × 10 − 4 \{1,2,3\}\times 10^{-4} on a sample of the training data found differences within noise, and we kept 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , the QLoRA default. Validation loss on the 600-ticket split, measured every 200 steps, fell from 1.255 at step 200 to its minimum, 1.101 (perplexity 3.0), at step 2,800, the end of the second epoch. In the third epoch training loss kept falling, to about 0.70, while validation loss rose to 1.17–1.18, the model beginning to memorise its training resolutions; early stopping ended the run after three evaluations without improvement, at step 3,400. The step-2,800 checkpoint was merged, converted to GGUF, quantized to 4 bits ( q4_K_M ), and served locally with Ollama, so a tool call is a local inference request. The model receives only the question: it was trained on single question–answer pairs, so the orchestrator passes it the router’s standalone rewrite of a follow-up rather than the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 微调后的模型。 使用 QLoRA [4, 7]，通过 Unsloth 在 RCAC Gilbreth 集群的一块 NVIDIA A10 GPU 上对 Llama-3-8B-Instruct [13] 进行了适配（表 2）。 每个样本是一次 system/user/assistant 交互；system 消息定义了一个 RCAC 支持智能体，该智能体提供面向用户的指导，从不编造技术细节，从不声称已执行后端操作，在需要时请求澄清，且从不索要凭据。 服务配置发送的 system 消息与之完全相同。 损失仅在 assistant 令牌上计算。 在一部分训练数据上对 {1,2,3}×10^-4 进行的初步扫描发现差异在噪声范围内，因此我们保留了 2×10^-4，即 QLoRA 的默认值。 在 600 张工单的验证集上，每 200 步测量一次验证损失，从第 200 步的 1.255 降至其最小值 1.101（困惑度 3.0），出现在第 2,800 步，即第二个 epoch 结束时。 在第三个 epoch 中，训练损失持续下降至约 0.70，而验证损失上升到 1.17–1.18，模型开始记忆其训练答案；在连续三次评估无改进后，早停在 3,400 步结束了训练。 第 2,800 步的检查点被合并、转换为 GGUF、量化为 4 位（q4_K_M），并通过 Ollama 在本地提供服务，因此一次工具调用就是一次本地推理请求。 模型只接收问题：它是基于单一问答对训练的，因此编排器向它传递的是路由器对后续追问的独立改写，而非整段对话。

paragraphs.en: Both tools are exposed through the Model Context Protocol, an open standard that declares each capability as a typed tool (name, description, JSON schema) discoverable by any MCP client. A FastMCP server publishes query_finetuned_model and query_rag_docs over stdio; the agent launches it as a subprocess and keeps a persistent client session. The decoupling is practical as much as architectural: the fine-tuned model and the RAG service were developed and redeployed independently throughout the project without touching the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 两个工具均通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）暴露，这是一个开放标准，它将每项能力声明为带有类型的工具（名称、描述、JSON schema），任何 MCP 客户端都可以发现这些工具。 一个 FastMCP 服务器通过 stdio 发布 query_finetuned_model 和 query_rag_docs；智能体将其作为子进程启动，并保持一个持久的客户端会话。 这种解耦既是架构上的，也是实际操作上的：微调模型和 RAG 服务在整个项目中都是独立开发和重新部署的，完全不需要改动智能体。

paragraphs.en: Each message is first handled by a lightweight routing prompt that sees the last few turns of the conversation. It decides whether the message is a technical question or conversation (greetings, thanks, questions about the assistant) and rewrites a follow-up such as “what about on the GPU nodes?” into a self-contained question before the tools see it; when in doubt, it treats the message as technical, and a message that names an RCAC cluster, service, or RCAC-specific command is never treated as conversation. Conversational messages are answered directly by Llama 3.1 with no tool calls. Technical messages trigger both tools concurrently ( asyncio.gather ), and a synthesis prompt merges the two outputs into one answer under an explicit rule: when the tools disagree on a concrete fact, a command, path, URL, prefer the documentation-grounded tool; otherwise, combine the useful parts of both answers. Before the answer is shown, any link that did not come from one of the tools is removed, so every page the assistant cites is one it actually retrieved. A tool that fails reports a typed error rather than an answer; the synthesis then works from the other tool and the answer says which source was unavailable. All generation runs at temperature 0. When GenAI Studio does not respond, the same model tag is served from a local Ollama instance instead, so an outage degrades latency rather than availability.
paragraphs.zh: 每条消息首先由一个轻量级路由提示词处理，该提示词只看到对话的最后几轮。 它判断该消息是技术问题还是闲聊（问候、感谢、关于智能体本身的提问），并在工具看到之前把诸如“那 GPU 节点上呢？”这样的追问改写成一个自成一体的独立问题；拿不准时，它将消息视为技术问题，而任何提到 RCAC 集群、服务或 RCAC 特定命令的消息永远不会被当作闲聊。 闲聊消息由 Llama 3.1 直接回答，不调用任何工具。 技术消息会并发触发两个工具（asyncio.gather），然后由一个综合提示词在明确的规则下将两个输出合并为一个答案：当两个工具在某个具体事实、命令、路径或 URL 上不一致时，优先采用基于文档的工具；否则，将两个答案中有用的部分结合起来。 在答案展示之前，任何并非来自工具之一的链接都会被移除，因此智能体引用的每个页面都是它实际检索过的。 失败的工具会报告一个类型化的错误而不是给出答案；随后综合环节基于另一个工具的输出继续工作，并且答案会说明哪个来源不可用。 所有生成均在温度 0 下运行。 当 GenAI Studio 无响应时，会改为由本地 Ollama 实例提供相同的模型标签，因此故障只会降低响应速度而不会导致服务不可用。

sents.en: Technical messages trigger both tools concurrently ( asyncio.gather ), and a synthesis prompt merges the two outputs into one answer under an explicit rule: when the tools disagree on a concrete fact, a command, path, URL, prefer the documentation-grounded tool; otherwise, combine the useful parts of both answers.
sents.zh: 技术消息会并发触发两个工具（asyncio.gather），然后由一个综合提示词在明确的规则下将两个输出合并为一个答案：当两个工具在某个具体事实、命令、路径或 URL 上不一致时，优先采用基于文档的工具；否则，将两个答案中有用的部分结合起来。

sents.en: Before the answer is shown, any link that did not come from one of the tools is removed, so every page the assistant cites is one it actually retrieved.
sents.zh: 在答案展示之前，任何并非来自工具之一的链接都会被移除，因此智能体引用的每个页面都是它实际检索过的。

sents.en: A tool that fails reports a typed error rather than an answer; the synthesis then works from the other tool and the answer says which source was unavailable.
sents.zh: 失败的工具会报告一个类型化的错误而不是给出答案；随后综合环节基于另一个工具的输出继续工作，并且答案会说明哪个来源不可用。

sents.en: All generation runs at temperature 0.
sents.zh: 所有生成均在温度 0 下运行。

sents.en: When GenAI Studio does not respond, the same model tag is served from a local Ollama instance instead, so an outage degrades latency rather than availability.
sents.zh: 当 GenAI Studio 无响应时，会改为由本地 Ollama 实例提供相同的模型标签，因此故障只会降低响应速度而不会导致服务不可用。

paragraphs.en: The agent runs as a CLI and as a FastAPI service that streams classification, tool calls, and synthesis to a chat-style web UI over server-sent events (Figure 2 ), so users see which sources were consulted and can follow a citation before running a command.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体以 CLI 和 FastAPI 服务的形式运行，通过服务器发送事件将分类、工具调用和综合结果流式传输到聊天式 Web UI（图 2），因此用户可以看到咨询了哪些来源，并在运行命令之前查看引用。

paragraphs.en: Systems and items. Five systems answer each of the 400 test questions: the base model, Llama-3-8B-Instruct served exactly like the fine-tuned model (same 4-bit quantization, same system prompt, temperature 0, no adapter); the fine-tuned model (Tool 2); RAG over the documentation (Tool 1); RAG over the training tickets; and the end-to-end agentic system. Tool 1, Tool 2, and the agentic system are queried through the deployed chat API, the code path users reach, each question in a fresh session with no history, so that no answer sees another evaluation item. Every answer is saved together with the model digests, the split hashes, the index version, and the code version. All 2,000 answers were produced; no system failed on any item.
paragraphs.zh: 系统与条目。 五个系统分别回答全部 400 道测试题：与微调模型完全相同部署方式的基础模型 Llama-3-8B-Instruct（相同的 4 位量化、相同的系统提示词、温度 0、无适配器）；微调模型（工具 2）；基于文档的 RAG（工具 1）；基于训练工单的 RAG；以及端到端智能体系统。 工具 1、工具 2 和智能体系统均通过部署的聊天 API（用户实际使用的代码路径）进行查询，每个问题都在无历史记录的全新会话中进行，因此任何答案都不会看到另一个评估条目。 每个答案都与模型摘要、切分哈希、索引版本和代码版本一并保存。 全部 2,000 个答案均已生成；没有任何系统在任何条目上失败。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Every answer is scored against the rewritten resolution of its test ticket. BERTScore F1 [ 30 ] (RoBERTa-large, baseline-rescaled) is the primary reference metric: it credits paraphrase but still compares content. ROUGE-1/2/L F1 [ 11 ] rewards exact tokens, which matters for commands and error strings, and penalises correct content absent from the reference. Cosine similarity between pooled all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings is reported as a secondary measure; it separates on-topic answers poorly. All three under-credit a correct answer that differs from the one recorded. An LLM judge [ 31 ] , given question, reference, and candidate, scores 1–5 on correctness (consistent with the reference; invented commands, paths, modules, URLs, or claims that staff performed an action are penalised), completeness (necessary steps and caveats present), and helpfulness (could the user resolve the issue, regardless of wording), and is told that length is not a merit.
paragraphs.zh: 评测指标。 每个答案都根据其测试工单改写后的解决方案进行评分。 BERTScore F1 [30]（RoBERTa-large，基线重缩放）是主要的参考指标：它认可改述，但仍会比较内容。 ROUGE-1/2/L F1 [11] 奖励完全一致的词元，这对命令和错误字符串很重要，但会惩罚参考答案中不存在的正确内容。 池化后的 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 嵌入的余弦相似度作为次要衡量指标；它很难区分切题的答案。 这三种指标都会低估与记录答案不同但正确的答案。 一个大模型裁判 [31] 在给定问题、参考答案和候选答案的情况下，从正确性（与参考答案一致；凭空编造的命令、路径、模块、URL 或声称工作人员执行过某操作的说法都会被扣分）、完整性（包含必要的步骤和注意事项）和有用性（无论措辞如何，用户能否解决问题）三个方面进行 1–5 分的评分，并被告知长度不是优点。

paragraphs.en: Judges. Every answer is judged by two models from families that generated none of the answers: Qwen2.5-72B and Gemma-3-27B, both on GenAI Studio, at temperature 0. All means come with 95% bootstrap intervals over items, and comparisons with Tool 2 use paired bootstrap intervals on the same items; an interval that contains zero is reported as no difference.

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning wins on agreement with staff resolutions. Over the base model served the same way, the adapter raises BERTScore F1 from 0.06 to 0.27, ROUGE-1 from 0.28 to 0.44, ROUGE-L from 0.16 to 0.27 and cosine from 0.70 to 0.74, all with intervals far from zero, and it does so with answers less than a third as long (76 vs. 255 words). The model absorbed RCAC’s vocabulary, response format, and recurring fixes. Part of this lead is built in: the model was trained to reproduce the register of exactly the kind of text it is scored against, and the reference answers are themselves LLM rewrites of staff replies. The judges, which do not reward register, give a more mixed picture (below).
paragraphs.zh: 微调在与人工裁决的一致性上更胜一筹。 与以相同方式服务的基座模型相比，适配器将 BERTScore F1 从 0.06 提升到 0.27，ROUGE-1 从 0.28 提升到 0.44，ROUGE-L 从 0.16 提升到 0.27，余弦相似度从 0.70 提升到 0.74，所有区间均远离零，而且其答案长度不到三分之一（76 词对 255 词）。 该模型吸收了 RCAC 的词汇、回复格式和常见修复方法。 这一优势有一部分是与生俱来的：该模型在训练时被要求复现的文体，正是其被评分所针对的那类文本，而参考答案本身也是由智能体对人工回复改写而成的。 不奖励文体的评审则给出了更为参差的图景（见下文）。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval over the same tickets is the weaker way to use them, but writes the most complete answers. Ticket-RAG falls well short of the fine-tuned model on every reference metric (BERTScore 0.12 vs. 0.27) and on judged correctness ( − 0.33 -0.33 ) and helpfulness ( − 0.15 -0.15 ), but it is judged the most complete system of all (3.11 vs. 2.85), and against the base model it ties on correctness and completeness. It paraphrases the resolutions of similar but different tickets into long, step-by-step answers, which carry more steps but more that do not apply. Ticket-RAG keeps one advantage the snapshot cannot show: it is updated by re-indexing rather than retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 对相同工单进行检索是使用它们的一种较弱方式，但能写出最完整的答案。 Ticket-RAG 在所有参考指标（BERTScore 0.12 对 0.27）、评判正确性（−0.33）和有用性（−0.15）上都远逊于微调后的模型，但它被评为所有系统中完整度最高的（3.11 对 2.85），并且与基础模型相比在正确性和完整度上持平。 它把相似但不同的工单的解决方案改写成冗长的分步答案，这些答案包含更多步骤，但其中更多步骤并不适用。 Ticket-RAG 保持了快照无法展现的一个优势：它通过重新索引而非重新训练来更新。

paragraphs.en: The end-to-end system does not improve on its tools. The agentic system is below Tool 2 on every metric and under both judges (correctness − 0.54 -0.54 on the mean, − 0.21 -0.21 by Qwen, − 0.87 -0.87 by Gemma). Against Tool 1 it is marginally ahead on the reference metrics (BERTScore + 0.02 +0.02 , [ + 0.01 , + 0.03 ] [+0.01,+0.03] ), which its shorter answers (112 vs. 154 words) and some of Tool 2’s ticket vocabulary account for, but behind on judged correctness ( − 0.12 -0.12 , [ − 0.20 , − 0.04 ] [-0.20,-0.04] ) and completeness ( − 0.18 -0.18 , [ − 0.26 , − 0.10 ] [-0.26,-0.10] ), with helpfulness tied. paragraphs.en: Selecting instead of merging recovers Tool 2’s quality, but no realisable selector beats Tool 2. paragraphs.en: The judges disagree about correctness. Averaged, the judges rate Tool 2 the most correct system. Separately they tell different stories (Table 5 ). Gemma-3-27B rates Tool 2 well above every other system, by 0.62–0.87 points. Qwen2.5-72B rates the base model slightly above Tool 2 ( − 0.13 -0.13 ) and finds no difference between Tool 2 and either RAG system; it is also more lenient overall (38% of answers scored 4–5 for correctness, against 16% for Gemma) and spreads its scores less. The two agree only moderately (Spearman ρ \rho 0.63 for correctness, 0.54 for helpfulness). On completeness and helpfulness Qwen again prefers the base model ( − 0.38 -0.38 and − 0.35 -0.35 for Tool 2), while Gemma finds no completeness difference and rates Tool 2 more helpful ( + 0.15 +0.15 ). Both judges agree that the agentic system is the least correct. The claim that fine-tuning improves correctness, as opposed to agreement with the reference, therefore depends on the judge.

paragraphs.en: Treat tickets as data, not as answers. The largest quality risk we encountered was not hallucination from the model but faithful reproduction of the wrong thing: resolutions in which a human did something the assistant cannot do. Rewriting those into “here is how to request this” guidance, and deleting status updates that were true for an afternoon, removed a whole class of confidently false answers, and a first, narrower filter still let 3% through. The same holds for privacy: pseudonymisation that looked complete still left thousands of usernames that a fine-tuned model can learn and repeat. Anyone fine-tuning on help-desk history should expect to iterate on both.
paragraphs.zh: 把工单当作数据，而不是答案。 我们遇到的最大质量风险并非模型产生幻觉，而是忠实地复现了错误的内容：那些由人类执行了智能体无法执行的操作的解决方案。 将这些内容改写为“如何申请此项”的指引，并删除那些仅在某个下午为真的状态更新，消除了一整类言之凿凿的错误答案，而第一道更严格的过滤器仍有 3% 漏网。 隐私方面也是如此：看似完备的假名化处理仍然留下了成千上万个用户名，微调后的模型可以学会并复述它们。 任何在客服台历史数据上进行微调的人，都应该预期在这两方面反复迭代。

paragraphs.en: Select, do not merge. Fine-tuning beat retrieval over the same tickets on every reference metric and, by one of two judges, on correctness, with answers a third the length. The orchestration failed in a specific place: the sources are complementary, but a rule that makes the documentation win on concrete facts made the synthesis track the documentation tool, and rewriting two answers into one lost content even when both were good. Selecting one answer recovers the fine-tuned tool’s quality but not the oracle’s headroom, so if one must choose today, returning the fine-tuned answer, with the documentation answer offered alongside as a cited second opinion, is safer than any merge we tried. Better selection signals, such as the retrieval relevance of the documentation evidence, a check of each answer’s commands against the cluster the question names, or user feedback, are the next step, as is a hybrid Tool 2 that retrieves recent tickets to stay current.
paragraphs.zh: 选择，而非合并。 在同样的工单上，微调在所有参考指标上胜过检索，并且在正确性上也获得两位评审之一的认可，而答案长度仅为三分之一。 编排在特定环节失效了：两个来源是互补的，但那条让文档在具体事实层面获胜的规则使合成结果跟随了文档工具，而且把两个答案改写为一个即使两者都很好也会丢失内容。 选择单一答案能恢复微调工具的质量，但无法达到先知答案的上限，因此如果今天必须做出选择，返回微调答案、同时将文档答案作为带引用的第二意见一并提供，比我们尝试过的任何合并方式都更安全。 更好的选择信号，例如文档证据的检索相关性、将每个答案中的命令与问题所指的集群进行核对，或者用户反馈，是下一步的方向；一个混合的 Tool 2 也是如此，它可以检索近期工单以保持时效性。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. All scores come from reference metrics and LLM judges, which disagree on the central correctness comparison and have not been validated against human ratings for this task. An expert evaluation is under way and will be added in a revision: RCAC support staff rate a blinded sample of test tickets, the staff resolution and four systems’ answers per question, for correctness, completeness, and whether they would send the answer to the user. The references are LLM-rewritten staff resolutions, the kind of text the fine-tuned model was trained on, which favours it on reference metrics; many concern account, allocation, or storage changes that only staff can make, which the documentation tool cannot answer from the guides. The selectors were tuned on validation labels from the same two judges, so they learn the judges’ preferences; the oracle uses test labels and is an upper bound, not a system. Because GenAI Studio rate-limited heavily, a local copy of the same model tag ( llama3.1:latest on Ollama) served part of the generation calls (643 of the documentation service’s, 149 of the agent’s, 51 of the 400 ticket-RAG answers, and 1,700 of the verifier’s), though no judge scores. GenAI Studio exposes model tags, not digests, so the hosted models can change underneath; the fine-tuned and base models are pinned by digest. No frontier model was compared, because ticket text could not leave the institution; the public documentation would allow such a comparison for Tool 1.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 所有分数均来自参考指标和 LLM 评委，二者在核心的正确性比较上存在分歧，且尚未针对本任务与人工评分进行校验。 专家评估正在进行中，并将在修订版中加入：RCAC 支持人员将对盲测的测试工单样本、人工解决方案以及每个问题的四个系统答案进行评分，评估其正确性、完整性，以及他们是否会将该答案发送给用户。 参考文本是由 LLM 重写的人工解决方案，正是微调模型所训练的那类文本，这使其在参考指标上占优；许多参考内容涉及只有工作人员才能进行的账户、配额或存储变更，而文档工具无法从指南中回答这些问题。 选择器是基于同两位评委的验证标签调优的，因此它们学习到了评委的偏好；oracle 使用测试标签，是上限而非一个系统。 由于 GenAI Studio 的速率限制非常严格，同一模型标签的本地副本（Ollama 上的 llama3.1:latest）承担了部分生成调用（文档服务的 643 次、智能体的 149 次、400 个工单 RAG 答案中的 51 个，以及验证器的 1,700 次），但未用于任何评委评分。 GenAI Studio 暴露的是模型标签而非摘要，因此托管模型可能在底层发生变化；微调模型和基础模型均通过摘要固定。 未比较前沿模型，因为工单文本不能离开该机构；对于工具 1，公开文档使得此类比较成为可能。

paragraphs.en: LLM assistants for HPC user support. This is now an active line at HPC-operations venues. AskHPC [ 3 ] is a RAG chatbot over user guides, scheduler manuals, and programming documentation at a leadership facility, with modality-aware parsing that keeps code blocks intact and a user study showing gains over vanilla RAG; it does not use ticket history. HPC-LLM [ 23 ] pairs QLoRA domain adaptation with retrieval, as we do, but trains on public documentation and synthetic instruction pairs rather than real resolutions.
paragraphs.zh: 面向HPC用户支持的LLM助手。 这如今已是HPC运维类会议上的一个活跃方向。 AskHPC[3]是某领先设施上基于用户指南、调度器手册和编程文档构建的RAG聊天机器人，它采用感知模态的解析方式以保持代码块完整，并通过用户研究展示了相对于普通RAG的性能提升；它不使用工单历史。 HPC-LLM[23]与我们的做法类似，将QLoRA领域自适应与检索相结合，但其训练数据是公开文档和合成指令对，而非真实的解决方案记录。

paragraphs.en: Closest to our evaluation, Zheng et al. [32] compare fine-tuning on historical tickets, RAG over documents, and in-context examples in eight combinations on roughly 60,000 TACC tickets, scoring accuracy and coherence. Relative to that work, we keep documentation and tickets in separate orchestrated tools rather than one prompt or one adapter, show that rewriting and filtering staff-performed resolutions is a prerequisite for a deployable assistant, and find that a simple precedence rule for merging the two sources does not combine their strengths.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们的评估最接近的是，Zheng 等人 [32] 在约 60,000 条 TACC 工单上，以八种组合比较了在历史工单上微调、基于文档的 RAG 以及上下文示例，并以准确性和连贯性进行评分。 相对于该工作，我们将文档和工单保存在各自独立的编排工具中，而不是放在一个提示词或一个适配器中；我们证明了重写和过滤由客服人员执行的解决方案是部署可用智能体的前提条件；并且我们发现，用于合并两种来源的简单优先级规则并不能结合它们各自的优势。

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning versus retrieval. Ovadia et al. [14] find that RAG consistently outperforms unsupervised fine-tuning for injecting new factual knowledge, while Balaguer et al. [2] find in an agricultural case study that the two are complementary and that fine-tuning chiefly buys style and domain fluency. Our results sit between them: fine-tuning beat retrieval over the same tickets on agreement with staff resolutions, consistent with capturing how RCAC answers, and fine-tuned and documentation answers were complementary in Balaguer et al. ’s sense, but merging them did not realise that complementarity.
paragraphs.zh: 微调与检索的对比。Ovadia 等人 [14] 发现，在注入新的 factual knowledge 方面，RAG 始终优于无监督微调，而 Balaguer 等人 [2] 在一个农业案例研究中发现，两者是互补的，微调主要带来的是风格和领域流畅度。 我们的结果介于两者之间：在同一批工单上，微调在与工作人员裁定结果的一致性上胜过检索，这与捕捉 RCAC 回答方式相吻合；同时，微调得到的回答与文档回答在 Balaguer 等人所说的意义上是互补的，但将二者合并并未实现这种互补性。

paragraphs.en: Agentic and tool-using LLMs. ReAct [ 28 ] established the loop of reasoning interleaved with tool calls; agentic RAG surveys [ 24 ] catalogue orchestrator-plus-tool designs in which retrieval is one capability among several; Sapkota et al. [22] distinguish single tool-augmented agents from multi-component agentic systems. The Model Context Protocol [ 1 ] standardises the tool interface we use. Our orchestrator is deliberately simple, one classification, two parallel tool calls, one synthesis; our results suggest the synthesis is where such a design needs the most care.

paragraphs.en: The knowledge needed to answer most HPC support tickets already exists, split between manuals that are current but generic and a ticket history that is specific but inaccessible. Within the constraints of on-premises models, fine-tuning a small model on carefully rewritten and filtered resolutions is an effective way to use that history: on 400 held-out tickets it agreed with RCAC’s resolutions far better than the base model or retrieval over the same tickets, and one of two judges rated it clearly the most correct. The two sources are complementary, but merging them under a documentation-first rule improved on neither, and selecting one answer recovers the fine-tuned tool’s quality without exceeding it: deciding in advance which source will be right is the open problem. The steps most responsible for a trustworthy assistant were data work: rewriting staff actions into self-service guidance, filtering what rewriting missed, and masking what pseudonymisation missed. Validating the judges against expert ratings, to be reported in a revision, and better signals for choosing the source are the next steps.
paragraphs.zh: 回答大多数 HLC 支持工单所需的知识其实早已存在，只是分散在两部分：手册内容及时却过于宽泛，工单历史具体却难以访问。 在本地部署模型的限制条件下，用经过仔细改写和筛选的解决方案对一个小模型进行微调，是利用这些历史工单的有效方式：在 400 个保留工单上，它与 RCAC 解决方案的一致性远高于基础模型或对相同工单的检索，并且两位评审之一明确认为它最为正确。 这两个知识来源是互补的，但在“文档优先”规则下将二者合并并没有带来任何一方的改进，而从中选择一个答案只能恢复微调工具的质量却无法超越它：如何预先判断哪个来源是正确的，仍是尚未解决的问题。 对构建一个值得信赖的智能体贡献最大的环节是数据工作：将工作人员的操作改写为自助指导，过滤掉改写遗漏的内容，并对假名化处理遗漏的信息进行脱敏。 下一步工作是：用专家评分来验证各个评审（将在修订版中报告），以及为选择知识来源寻找更好的信号。
